entities.summary: Fuad Aslanov is an Azerbaijani boxer who competed in the flyweight division at the 2004 Summer Olympics and won the bronze medal. He qualified for the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, ending up in second place at the 3rd AIBA European 2004 Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Gothenburg.
